<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv = null then (application.loan.amount / (if application.purpose = "purchase" then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100) else application.ltv</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti = null then ((sum(for v in [application.housing.principalInterest, application.housing.taxes, application.housing.insurance, application.housing.hoa, application.housing.mip] return if v = null then 0 else v) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100) else application.dti</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">

          <text></text>

        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">

        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceTrue
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference triggers Fixed30 (rule 1)

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 even without fixed preference (rule 1)

testSuite.name: TC03_FixedRuleOverridesManualReview
testSuite.description: Rule 1 is evaluated first, so high rate sensitivity with low credit score yields Fixed30 instead of ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMBoundaryValues
testSuite.description: All ARM 7/1 conditions at exact boundaries: horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720, stable income

testSuite.name: TC05_ARMTypicalShortHorizon
testSuite.description: Typical short-horizon stable borrower with good credit and low LTV gets ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC06_HorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years exceeds the 7-year ARM limit and no other rule applies, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC07_VariableIncomeNoARM
testSuite.description: Variable income blocks ARM 7/1 and no manual rule applies, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC08_LTVJustAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds the ARM limit of 80 and no manual rule applies, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditScoreJustBelowARMLimit
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below the ARM threshold of 720 and no manual rule applies, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditScoreBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so the application goes to manual review

testSuite.name: TC11_CreditScoreExactly640NoManual
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640, DTI 50 and LTV 95 are not above thresholds, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC12_DTIAboveLimit
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 exceeds 50 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC13_LTVAboveLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC14_LTVExactly95NoManual
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above the threshold, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC15_LowCreditAndHighDTI
testSuite.description: Low credit score combined with high DTI triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC16_AllNullsNoRule
testSuite.description: Application with null credit score, horizon and other key fields matches no rule, so no product is assigned

ARM7/1: короткий горизонт + стабільний профіль

Очікувано: ManualReview (бо creditScore < 640)

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceTrue
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference triggers Fixed30 (rule 1) with otherwise ARM-eligible attributes

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 without explicit fixed preference

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMBoundaryAllInclusive
testSuite.description: Boundary values horizon=7, LTV=80, creditScore=720 with stable income yield ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC04_HorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds ARM limit; no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC05_LTVJustAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.01 exceeds ARM limit and is not above 95; no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditBelowARMThresholdNoManual
testSuite.description: Credit 719 fails ARM threshold but does not meet manual review criteria (>=640)

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditBelow640ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditExactly640NoManual
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC09_DTIExactly50NoManual
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC10_DTIAbove50ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 exceeds 50 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC11_LTVExactly95NoManual
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC12_LTVAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95 and triggers manual review even with good credit

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedPreferenceOverridesManual
testSuite.description: Fixed preference has priority (FIRST policy) over manual review criteria

testSuite.name: TC14_VariableIncomeNoARM
testSuite.description: Variable income blocks ARM even though other ARM criteria are met; no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC15_NullStabilityAndPreferences
testSuite.description: Null income stability, rate sensitivity and fixed preference match no rule

testSuite.name: TC16_ARMLowRiskProfile
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, low LTV and high credit score yield ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC17_CreditZeroManualReview
testSuite.description: Minimum credit score triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC18_ManualReviewMultipleCriteria
testSuite.description: Low credit, high DTI and high LTV simultaneously trigger manual review

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmBoundaryAllInclusive
testSuite.description: Horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720, stable income gives ARM7/1 (boundary values included).

testSuite.name: TC05_ArmIncomeVariable

testSuite.name: TC06_ArmLtvJustAboveLimit

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditScoreExactly640NoRule

testSuite.name: TC13_LtvExactlyNinetyFiveNoRule
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no other rule applies, so no product.

testSuite.name: TC16_LowCreditShortHorizonManualReview

testSuite.name: TC18_ZeroHorizonAndLtvArm

testSuite.name: TC20_MediumSensitivityLongHorizonNoRule

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceTrue
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference triggers Fixed30 (rule 1), even with otherwise strong ARM-eligible attributes

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 (rule 1)

testSuite.name: TC03_RuleOrderFixedOverManual
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with low credit score: rule 1 precedes manual review rule, so Fixed30 is returned under FIRST policy

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMBoundaryAllValuesAtLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7 years, stable income, LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720 triggers ARM7/1 (rule 2 boundaries)

testSuite.name: TC05_ARMTypicalCase
testSuite.description: Typical short-horizon stable-income borrower with good credit gets ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC06_HorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7, so ARM rule fails; no other rule matches, no output

testSuite.name: TC07_LTVJustAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds 80, ARM rule fails; not above 95 so no manual review, no output

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScoreBelowARMLimit
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720 for ARM, and not below 640, so no output

testSuite.name: TC09_VariableIncomeBlocksARM
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM rule; other attributes are fine, so no output

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditScoreJustBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC11_CreditScoreExactly640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no manual review, no output

testSuite.name: TC12_DTIAboveLimit
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 exceeds 50, triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC13_DTIExactlyAtLimit
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no manual review, no output

testSuite.name: TC14_LTVAboveLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95, triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC15_LTVExactlyAtLimit
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no manual review, no output

testSuite.name: TC16_ManualReviewMultipleTriggers
testSuite.description: Low credit score, high DTI and high LTV all at once triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC17_FixedPreferenceFalseNoRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: Fixed preference explicitly false and low sensitivity, nothing matched with mid-range attributes, no output

testSuite.name: TC18_AllNullDecisionInputs
testSuite.description: All decision-relevant inputs are null; no rule matches, no output

testSuite.name: TC19_NullFixedAndSensitivityWithARMValues
testSuite.description: Null preference and sensitivity do not trigger Fixed30; ARM criteria met, returns ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC20_NullCreditScoreNoManualReview
testSuite.description: Null credit score does not satisfy the <640 condition; ARM not met due to null, no output

testSuite.name: TC21_ZeroHorizonARM
testSuite.description: Zero horizon years with stable income, good credit and low LTV triggers ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMHorizonBoundarySeven

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveSeven

testSuite.name: TC06_LTVJustAbove80

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScore719NoARM

testSuite.name: TC08_VariableIncomeNoARM

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditScore639ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditScore640Boundary
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; LTV 90 blocks ARM; no product.

testSuite.name: TC12_DTIAbove50ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC13_LTVExactly95NoManual

testSuite.name: TC14_LTVAbove95ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC17_ARMBeforeDTIManualReview

testSuite.name: TC18_AllNullInputs

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.ltv = null) then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if not(application.collateral.purchasePrice = null) and not(application.collateral.appraisedValue = null) then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else if not(application.collateral.appraisedValue = null) then application.collateral.appraisedValue else application.collateral.purchasePrice) * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.dti = null) then application.dti else (application.housing.principalInterest + application.housing.taxes + application.housing.insurance + (if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa) + (if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-5">
          <text>> 95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else if application.loan.amount != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue > 0 then application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100 else null</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else if application.income.grossMonthly != null and application.income.grossMonthly > 0 then (application.housing.principalInterest + application.housing.taxes + application.housing.insurance + application.housing.hoa + application.housing.mip + sum(application.debts[include != false].monthlyPayment)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100 else null</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">

          <text></text>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else (application.housing.principalInterest + application.housing.taxes + application.housing.insurance + application.housing.hoa + application.housing.mip + sum(application.debts[include != false].monthlyPayment)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-5">
          <text>> 95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceTrue
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference triggers Fixed30 (rule 1)

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 when fixedPreference is false

testSuite.name: TC03_ARM71_Typical
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, low LTV and good credit yield ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC04_ARM71_BoundaryValues
testSuite.description: Boundary values: horizon 7 years, LTV 80, credit score 720 still qualify for ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveSeven

testSuite.name: TC06_VariableIncomeBlocksARM
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM criteria and no manual review condition met, so no product

testSuite.name: TC07_LTVJustAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 fails ARM LTV limit; no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditBelow640ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640 routes to manual review

testSuite.name: TC09_BoundaryCredit640_DTI50_NoRule
testSuite.description: Boundary values: credit 640 and DTI 50 do not trigger manual review; no product assigned

testSuite.name: TC10_DTIAbove50ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI just above 50 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC11_LTVAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV above 95 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC12_FixedPreferenceOverridesLowCredit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference matches rule 1 first (FIRST policy), even though credit is below 640

testSuite.name: TC13_ARMCriteriaOverridesDTIManualReview
testSuite.description: ARM criteria met (rule 2) takes precedence over manual review (rule 3) under FIRST policy despite DTI above 50

testSuite.description: Null sensitivity and preference with moderate credit and high LTV-free profile matches no rule

testSuite.description: Very low credit score with fixed preference returns Fixed30 under FIRST policy

<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="application.fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="application.rateSensitivity">

      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="application.incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="application.ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if application.collateral.purchasePrice != null then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="application.creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="application.dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else ((if application.housing.principalInterest != null then application.housing.principalInterest else 0) + (if application.housing.taxes != null then application.housing.taxes else 0) + (if application.housing.insurance != null then application.housing.insurance else 0) + (if application.housing.hoa != null then application.housing.hoa else 0) + (if application.housing.mip != null then application.housing.mip else 0) + (if application.debts != null then sum(application.debts[include != false].monthlyPayment) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>

          <text></text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="application.fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="application.rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="application.horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="application.incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="application.ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.ltv = null) then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if not(application.collateral.purchasePrice = null) and not(application.collateral.appraisedValue = null) then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else if not(application.collateral.appraisedValue = null) then application.collateral.appraisedValue else application.collateral.purchasePrice) * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="application.creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="application.dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.dti = null) then application.dti else ((if application.housing.principalInterest = null then 0 else application.housing.principalInterest) + (if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes) + (if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance) + (if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa) + (if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-5">
          <text>> 95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if application.purpose = "purchase" then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100</text>

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceExplicit

testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so the application goes to ManualReview (rule 3).

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditScoreExactly640NoManual
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC11_DtiAbove50ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC12_DtiExactly50NoManual
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC13_LtvAbove95ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC14_LtvExactly95NoManual
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC15_LowScoreNoPreferenceManualReview
testSuite.description: Low credit score with no fixed preference or high sensitivity yields ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC16_AllNullsNoRuleApplies
testSuite.description: All decision inputs are null; no rule condition is satisfied, so no product is assigned.

<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>

      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>

      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">

      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.dti</text>

      </input>

      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>

      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">

        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">

        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>

      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>

testSuite.name: ArmBoundaryInclusive

testSuite.name: ArmTypicalLowRisk

testSuite.name: HorizonJustAboveSeven

testSuite.name: LtvJustAboveEighty
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds ARM limit but is not above 95, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: CreditScoreExactlyManualThreshold

testSuite.name: DtiAboveFiftyManualReview

testSuite.name: DtiExactlyFifty
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: LtvAboveNinetyFiveManualReview

testSuite.name: LtvExactlyNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: VariableIncomeBlocksArm
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM criteria; credit and DTI are acceptable, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: LowCreditVariableIncomeManualReview
testSuite.description: Low credit score with variable income fails ARM and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: NullableFieldsNoRuleMatch
testSuite.description: Null credit score and horizon with no preference and no LTV/DTI breach match no rule

testSuite.name: MediumSensitivityArmEligible
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity and no fixed preference with ARM criteria met assigns ARM7/1

<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">

      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if application.collateral.purchasePrice != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue != null then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else if application.collateral.appraisedValue != null then application.collateral.appraisedValue else application.collateral.purchasePrice) * 100</text>

          <text>"Fixed30"</text>

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceTrue
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference yields Fixed30 (rule 1 takes priority over ARM criteria that would also match).

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity yields Fixed30 even without fixed preference.

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMBoundaryValues
testSuite.description: Horizon 7 years, stable income, LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720 yields ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMHorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years exceeds the ARM limit, no rule applies, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC05_ARMVariableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM criteria and no other rule matches, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC06_ARMCreditScoreJustBelowThreshold
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 fails ARM threshold of 720 and no manual review rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, routing to manual review.

testSuite.name: TC08_DTIAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI of 51 exceeds 50, routing to manual review.

testSuite.name: TC09_DTIExactlyBoundary
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so no rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC10_LTVAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV of 96 exceeds 95, routing to manual review.

testSuite.name: TC11_LTVExactlyBoundary
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, so no rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC12_CreditScoreExactly640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, so no rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedPreferenceOverridesManualReview
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with low credit score and high DTI yields Fixed30 because rule 1 is evaluated first (FIRST hit policy).

testSuite.name: TC14_AllAttributesNull
testSuite.description: All decision attributes are null, so no rule can match and no product is assigned.
